attempt1: Propose the full past-due amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much, on the last business day of this week; if today is that day, use the last business day of next week; if that date is after the deadline, use the deadline.

opening.text: Hello, this is Kestrel Bank's digital assistant, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you pay all of them today?

ai.text: I am Kestrel Bank's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning Kestrel Bank's customer service number.

failed_id.text: I could not verify your identity, so please use the Kestrel app or visit a branch.

paid_reply.text: Thank you, payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: Let me check that new detail and read it back to you.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

id_reason.text: These questions are there to protect your account.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am very sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Could you say your date of birth again, with the month as a word?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, could you confirm: am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive a text message confirming each promise.

extra_rules.statement: Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirms the right party; answer a customer question first, and the ask that follows counts as the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: With a third party, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, do not give the reason for the call, and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence. Ask when the customer can be reached.

extra_rules.statement: A callback time must be later than now.
extra_rules.brief_quote: and later than `now`

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or hear account details, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

extra_rules.statement: Read a date of birth given only as numbers as day, then month, then year, and send it as YYYY-MM-DD.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: A retry after the day_month_swapped hint does not count as a wrong answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: Asking what the call is about instead of answering a security question counts as declining.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after every security question has passed.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything; band and deadline are per product.
extra_rules.brief_quote: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline; for a weekend or holiday on or before the deadline, offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: For a date after the deadline, say the latest date that can be recorded is the deadline and offer it; refusing the deadline is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it

extra_rules.statement: For a vague period, ask once for the exact day; if none is given, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Never ask how much the customer can pay; the agent proposes every amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: When offering the floor, say that the rest stays overdue; offer it only once, and refusing it is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue.

extra_rules.statement: Accept an amount from the floor up to the full amount; below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount proposed by the customer is never a refusal; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

extra_rules.statement: On hardship, make no persuasion attempt and offer the support team; if the customer still names a date or amount, record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: make no persuasion attempt. Offer to connect them with the support team.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: For a dispute, do not argue and take no promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: For a restructuring request, do not describe a plan.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: A request for a human applies before and after verification: ask once whether you can help first, then transfer if they insist.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies before and after verification.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk before identity is verified, close as not_verified / declined instead of no_promise / refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Before identity is verified, close as `not_verified` / `declined`.

extra_rules.statement: With multiple products, first ask about paying all today; then handle products one by one in get_account order, without asking about today again, starting each at attempt 1.
extra_rules.brief_quote: go through the products one by one, in the order `get_account` returned them, without asking about today again.

extra_rules.statement: If one date given for everything is after a product's deadline, record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back.
extra_rules.brief_quote: record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back

extra_rules.statement: Read back product, amount and date; call create_promise only after a clear yes; with several products, read all back together with one confirmation, then call create_promise once per product.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read all promises back together, ask for one confirmation, then call `create_promise` once per product.

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

extra_rules.statement: Say a promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: If one create_promise fails twice, keep recorded promises and note the failed product with system_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: keep the promises that were recorded and note the failed product with reason `system_error`

extra_rules.statement: Call add_note for every product that ends without a promise, including single-product calls; a dispute or already-paid claim on one product does not end the call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This also applies when no product gets a promise, and when there is only one product.

extra_rules.statement: On restructuring, promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded; on support or human transfer, add no notes.
extra_rules.brief_quote: promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded

extra_rules.statement: promise wins if at least one promise was recorded, except on a transfer; if every product is noted already_paid, close as paid; if a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: Thank the customer and say goodbye before close_call, which is the last tool call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Thank the customer and say goodbye before it.

extra_rules.statement: Pass customer_id to every tool call; all date rules use now, never the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

extra_rules.statement: The brief gives no account_ref id format.
extra_rules.brief_quote: each with its own `account_ref`

_source./address: Address the customer as title plus last name.

_source./bands/1/attempts: | 10 to 50 | late | the 6th business day after today | 2 |

_source./weekday_words/this: "This <weekday>" means the one in the current week.

_source./identity/max_wrong: Three wrong answers in total end the check

_source./notes_on_restructuring: call `add_note` with reason `declined` for every product without a recorded promise

_source./product_types/car_loan/floor_field: `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan
